setup: CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS tracehouse_object_demo __ON_CLUSTER__ ENGINE = Atomic
CREATE ROLE IF NOT EXISTS th_ob_reader __ON_CLUSTER__
CREATE ROLE IF NOT EXISTS th_ob_analyst __ON_CLUSTER__
CREATE ROLE IF NOT EXISTS th_ob_writer __ON_CLUSTER__
CREATE USER IF NOT EXISTS th_ob_alice __ON_CLUSTER__ HOST NONE
CREATE USER IF NOT EXISTS th_ob_bob __ON_CLUSTER__ HOST NONE
CREATE USER IF NOT EXISTS th_ob_carol __ON_CLUSTER__ HOST NONE
CREATE USER IF NOT EXISTS th_ob_denied __ON_CLUSTER__ HOST NONE

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tracehouse_object_demo.events __ON_CLUSTER__ (
 id UInt64, tenant_id UInt32, event_time DateTime, amount UInt64
) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (tenant_id, event_time, id)
 TTL event_time + INTERVAL 30 DAY DELETE SETTINGS index_granularity = 4096

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tracehouse_object_demo.events_minute __ON_CLUSTER__ (
 tenant_id UInt32, minute DateTime, amount UInt64, events UInt64
) ENGINE = SummingMergeTree ORDER BY (tenant_id, minute)
 TTL minute + INTERVAL 90 DAY DELETE

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tracehouse_object_demo.events_hourly __ON_CLUSTER__ (
 tenant_id UInt32, hour DateTime, amount UInt64, events UInt64
) ENGINE = SummingMergeTree ORDER BY (tenant_id, hour)
 TTL hour + INTERVAL 365 DAY DELETE

CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW IF NOT EXISTS tracehouse_object_demo.minute_to_hourly_mv __ON_CLUSTER__
 TO tracehouse_object_demo.events_hourly AS SELECT tenant_id, toStartOfHour(minute) AS hour,
 sum(amount) AS amount, sum(events) AS events FROM tracehouse_object_demo.events_minute GROUP BY tenant_id, hour

CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW IF NOT EXISTS tracehouse_object_demo.events_to_minute_mv __ON_CLUSTER__
 TO tracehouse_object_demo.events_minute AS SELECT tenant_id, toStartOfMinute(event_time) AS minute,
 sum(amount) AS amount, count() AS events FROM tracehouse_object_demo.events GROUP BY tenant_id, minute

CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS tracehouse_object_demo.hourly_report __ON_CLUSTER__ AS
 SELECT tenant_id, hour, sum(amount) AS amount, sum(events) AS events
 FROM tracehouse_object_demo.events_hourly GROUP BY tenant_id, hour

CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS tracehouse_object_demo.events_public __ON_CLUSTER__ AS
 SELECT id, tenant_id, event_time FROM tracehouse_object_demo.events
GRANT __ON_CLUSTER__ SELECT ON tracehouse_object_demo.events TO th_ob_reader
GRANT __ON_CLUSTER__ SELECT ON tracehouse_object_demo.* TO th_ob_analyst
REVOKE __ON_CLUSTER__ SELECT ON tracehouse_object_demo.audit_log FROM th_ob_analyst
GRANT __ON_CLUSTER__ INSERT ON tracehouse_object_demo.events TO th_ob_writer
GRANT __ON_CLUSTER__ th_ob_reader TO th_ob_analyst
GRANT __ON_CLUSTER__ th_ob_reader TO th_ob_alice
GRANT __ON_CLUSTER__ th_ob_analyst TO th_ob_bob
GRANT __ON_CLUSTER__ th_ob_writer TO th_ob_carol
SET DEFAULT ROLE th_ob_reader TO th_ob_alice __ON_CLUSTER__
SET DEFAULT ROLE NONE TO th_ob_bob __ON_CLUSTER__
SET DEFAULT ROLE th_ob_writer TO th_ob_carol __ON_CLUSTER__
CREATE ROW POLICY IF NOT EXISTS tenant_42 __ON_CLUSTER__ ON tracehouse_object_demo.events USING tenant_id = 42 TO th_ob_alice
CREATE ROW POLICY IF NOT EXISTS other_observers __ON_CLUSTER__ ON tracehouse_object_demo.events USING 1 TO ALL EXCEPT th_ob_alice
CREATE SETTINGS PROFILE IF NOT EXISTS th_ob_reporting __ON_CLUSTER__ SETTINGS max_threads = 2, max_memory_usage = 268435456 TO th_ob_reader
CREATE QUOTA IF NOT EXISTS th_ob_quota __ON_CLUSTER__ KEYED BY user_name FOR INTERVAL 1 HOUR MAX queries = 10000 TO th_ob_reader
seed:

 toStartOfHour(now()) + toIntervalMinute(number % 3), (number + 1) * 10
 FROM numbers(6) WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tracehouse_object_demo.events WHERE event_time >= toStartOfHour(now()) AND event_time < toStartOfHour(now()) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR LIMIT 1)
